author: PokerFace
body:
Hey avicus! I just thought about this idea and its so simple. I don't see why this wasn't added earlier.

1. My idea is a chat censor to block out all those nasty swear words. Instead, you can replace the swear word with those asterisks ****. You could also replace it with something like
 [^\IM NOT SWEARING/^] This concept can also be used with advertising. There is this skyblock server that when you type an ip, it says something like *=*I love skyblock*=* and it just repeats its ip afterwards. 

2. When players type in CAPS, you can have a chat editor/formatter plugin which makes the "CAPS" into "Caps" or "caps".                                          
Thank you guys for reading this! Hopefully this can be taken into effect and mods can enjoy the game more. Now what's in it for all the regular players you ask? You can avoid all those ******* infractions. Thank you!                       ^^^^^^^ IT WORKS!!!                            P.S (Im gonna give this forum link to IvyCode in skype to see what he has to say in case he doesn't see it in the forums.)

replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body:
There used to be a chat filter before Avicore, where it would replace swear words with asterisks. The reason it was removed was that it was unpredictable, and would censor out something like "finish it".

I believe there also was an IP censor, where it would tell you that advertising isn't allowed. The IP censor should be added back, but swear filters shouldn't. If someone is swearing excessively, then just report them, but if it's just one word, it should be fine.

replies.author: PictureFrames
replies.body:
For example, (as Gill said) one form of trolling the staff into thinking they're swearing could actually be typing "****" to make it look like they're swearing a four letter word. They do it to make the staff think they're swearing, to see it we'll punish them. However if we do end up punishing them, they usually end up writing appeals/complaints that our staff "don't do our job" and that we punished them for an unfair reason.

Basic method of trolling that has happened multiple times.

I clearly disagree with this.

For the following reasons:

1. If we added this someone may not have sweared but said something that has part a swear word in it but not a swear word. Also this can be used to troll as one staff member stated " one form of trolling the staff into thinking they're swearing could actually be typing "****" to make it look like they're swearing a four letter word. However if we do end up punishing them, they usually end up writing appeals/complaints that our staff "don't do our job" and that we punished them for an unfair reason. "

Thus, no messages including Internet links, IP addresses, websites, abusive language or full caps will NOT be allowed in the public chat. So, no prefixes will be needed to block the message, the message will not be sent at all. " There is something simular to this. Perhaps it could say on normal chat " I love chocolate " lol this probably won't happen

Now I have argued for both points but I really disagree
